<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.openshopify.omnishop">
    
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA"/>
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.camera" android:required="false" />
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.camera.autofocus" android:required="false" />

    <application
        android:label="OmniShop POS"
        android:name="${applicationName}"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher">
        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTop"
            android:theme="@style/LaunchTheme"
            android:configChanges="orientation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|screenSize|smallestScreenSize|locale|layoutDirection|fontScale|screenLayout|density|uiMode"
            android:hardwareAccelerated="true"
            android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize">
            <meta-data
              android:name="io.flutter.embedding.android.NormalTheme"
              android:resource="@style/NormalTheme"
              />
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <meta-data
            android:name="flutterEmbedding"
            android:value="2" />
    </application>
</manifest>

platform :ios, '14.0'

# CocoaPods analytics sends network stats
ENV['COCOAPODS_DISABLE_STATS'] = 'true'

project 'Runner', {
  'Debug' => :debug,
  'Profile' => :release,
  'Release' => :release,
}

def flutter_root
  generated_xcode_build_settings_path = File.expand_path(File.join('..', 'Flutter', 'Generated.xcconfig'), __FILE__)
  unless File.exist?(generated_xcode_build_settings_path)
    raise "#{generated_xcode_build_settings_path} must exist. If you're running pod install manually, make sure flutter pub get is executed first"
  end

  File.foreach(generated_xcode_build_settings_path) do |line|
    matches = line.match(/FLUTTER_ROOT\=(.*)/)
    return matches[1].strip if matches
  end
  raise "FLUTTER_ROOT not found in #{generated_xcode_build_settings_path}. Try deleting Generated.xcconfig, then run flutter pub get"
end

require File.expand_path(File.join('packages', 'flutter_tools', 'bin', 'podhelper'), flutter_root)

flutter_ios_podfile_setup

target 'Runner' do
  use_frameworks!
  use_modular_headers!

  flutter_install_all_ios_pods File.dirname(File.realpath(__FILE__))
  target 'RunnerTests' do
    inherit! :search_paths
  end
end

post_install do |installer|
  installer.pods_project.targets.each do |target|
    flutter_additional_ios_build_settings(target)
  end
end

name: omnishop
description: "OmniShop — Open Shopify Sovereign Multi-Platform Client & POS (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux)"
version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ">=3.3.0 <4.0.0"

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_riverpod: ^2.5.1
  http: ^1.2.1
  intl: ^0.19.0

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^3.0.0

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(omnishop LANGUAGES CXX)

set(BINARY_NAME "omnishop")

cmake_policy(SET CMP0079 NEW)

# Flutter CMake build configuration
set(FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/flutter")

# Application build configuration
add_subdirectory("runner")

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(runner LANGUAGES CXX)

set(BINARY_NAME "omnishop")

add_executable(${BINARY_NAME} WIN32
  "main.cpp"
  "Runner.rc"
)

apply_standard_settings(${BINARY_NAME})
target_compile_definitions(${BINARY_NAME} PRIVATE
  "_UNICODE"
  "UNICODE"
)

#include <windows.h>

#define VERSION_AS_NUMBER 1,0,0,0
#define VERSION_AS_STRING "1.0.0.0"

VS_VERSION_INFO VERSIONINFO
FILEVERSION VERSION_AS_NUMBER
PRODUCTVERSION VERSION_AS_NUMBER
FILEFLAGSMASK 0x3fL
#ifdef _DEBUG
FILEFLAGS 0x1L
#else
FILEFLAGS 0x0L
#endif
FILEOS 0x40004L
FILETYPE 0x1L
FILESUBTYPE 0x0L
BEGIN
    BLOCK "StringFileInfo"
    BEGIN
        BLOCK "040904e4"
        BEGIN
            VALUE "CompanyName", "Open Shopify Contributors" "\0"
            VALUE "FileDescription", "OmniShop POS & Terminal" "\0"
            VALUE "FileVersion", VERSION_AS_STRING "\0"
            VALUE "InternalName", "omnishop" "\0"
            VALUE "LegalCopyright", "Copyright (C) 2026 Open Shopify Contributors. All rights reserved." "\0"
            VALUE "OriginalFilename", "omnishop.exe" "\0"
            VALUE "ProductName", "OmniShop" "\0"
            VALUE "ProductVersion", VERSION_AS_STRING "\0"
        END
    END
    BLOCK "VarFileInfo"
    BEGIN
        VALUE "Translation", 0x409, 1252
    END
END
